title: Attio changelog
description: A white framed changelog: a blue badge, a two-tone 40px heading and a small arrow button, four recent releases (date, title, two grey lines) in hairline-ruled columns standing on a strip of fine vertical ticks (a snapping sideways scroller on phones), then a newsletter row: a two-tone 24px line on the left, an email field and a near-black button on the right (stacked and centred on phones).
